name: ES Aggressor Causality Switch v1
instrument: ES transaction-level signal executed with one MES using recorded MBP-1 quotes
source: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ES trades and MES MBP-1
hypothesis: Net aggressor flow has different meaning when aggressors are locally informed versus locally absorbed. The signed, size-weighted next-transaction price response estimates whether aggression is predictive. Follow net flow when that response is positive; fade net flow when it is negative.

signal.next_trade_response: for each trade except the last, next transaction price minus current transaction price
signal.causality_score: sum(current trade size * current aggressor sign * next-trade price response)
signal.interpretation: positive causality follows net flow; negative causality fades net flow
signal.zero_or_missing_rule: no trade if net flow or causality score is zero, or either aggressor side is absent

eligibility.entry_and_exit_quotes: finite, positive, non-crossed recorded MBP-1 bid and ask
eligibility.spread_filter: none; cross the recorded spread regardless of width

execution.entry_time: first MES MBP-1 record at or after 15:30:05 ET
execution.stop: none; one MES and a fixed approximately 29-minute holding period bound exposure
execution.exit_time: first recorded MES MBP-1 quote at or after 15:59:45 ET
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

economics.slippage_model: the full recorded MES bid-ask spread is crossed at entry and exit; no additional modeled slippage

lesson: Size-weighted next-transaction response did not distinguish flow worth following from flow worth fading. The frozen switch lost in every year. Its near-flat short result is not permission to select shorts or negate the switch.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: negating the causality switch after observing results
using same-trade, fixed-horizon, bar, or quote response instead of next-transaction response
adding flow or causality magnitude thresholds
changing either trade or quote window
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
